title.narrative: MATERNAL, NEWBORN, CHILD HEALTH, HIV SERVICES AND IMMUNIZATION

description.narrative: Increased access and use of quality maternal, neonatal and child health care services, including Prevention of Mother to Child Transmission of HIV (PMTCT) and Pediatric ART services, by pregnant and lactating women, neonates and infants particularly in the most deprived geographic areas, including emergency prone provinces and peri-urban Luanda.

sector.narrative: Evidence generation and policy advocacy for immunization
Facility based maternal and newborn care (including emergency obstetric and newborn care, quality improvement)
HIV and AIDS monitoring and bottleneck analysis
HIV health and community system strengthening to improve access and adherence
IMNCI / Integrated Community Case Management (iCCM) - Community
Immunization supply chain, including cold chain
Maternal and newborn care policy advocacy, evidence generation, national / subnational capacity development
Measles and rubella supplementary immunization activities
Technical assistance - Immunization (excluding Polio technical assistance)
Technical assistance - Maternal and newborn health
